structured_output.what_is_happening: "超级智能" (Super Intelligence) is a Chinese-named token, about 2.2h old. Its pool was created directly on PumpSwap; the contract address has no 'pump' suffix and there is no curve migration. Over 6h it rose about 800%, and 400%+ in the last hour, to roughly $95k market cap with $68k liquidity. Volume in the last hour was about $900k (13.7x turnover), but GeckoTerminal counts only 99 unique buyers and 99 unique sellers in that hour across ~2,250 trades. At least 10 other 'Super Intelligence'/超级智能 clones launched in the past day, and most now show zero liquidity.

narrative.why_spreading: Many same-name clones launched within ~40h, which points to an outside trigger (possibly a post by a large account). Chinese-name memes have had waves of attention. The packet contains no project links, socials or description.

authenticity.evidence: Across 6h, 2,109 unique buyers against only 104 unique sellers suggests broad early buying. In the last hour, though, only ~99 buyers and ~99 sellers produced ~2,250 trades and $890k of volume, which looks like a small group of bots or active traders churning. GMGN tags 8 bundler wallets (top bundler share 8.6%) and zero smart or renowned wallets. It flags no paid DexScreener promotion. Top-10 holders (excluding the pool) hold only 18%, which is fairly spread out.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X or Telegram data. The unique-buyer counts from different sources may not be directly comparable.

The creator wallet is closed and the funding source is unknown
The price is already up 800% and the move is extended, so entering at +4 minutes risks buying near the top
Last-hour trading is concentrated in about 100 wallets and looks like churn

structured_output.thesis: The coin sits in a hot but heavily farmed Chinese meme. Momentum is strong, but the LP was added by the creator and is 100% unlocked, several sibling clones already appear rugged, and after an 800% move the recent volume comes from only about 100 churning wallets. There is some chance of a further leg up, but the risk of a rug or a -50% move comes first. For this pool, runner odds are below average to average.
